description: Return how the in-app bug widget looks for one project, as the console sets it (served to installed SDKs at startup, no redeploy): { projectId, enabled (false: SDKs ignore console settings), canEdit, widget: { position, theme (auto | light | dark | inherit), triggerText (null = the default bug icon), accent (a #rrggbb brand colour, or "auto" to match the site), accentText (the black or white text Mushi checked against the accent, null when auto), launcher (auto | banner | edge-tab | attach | manual | hidden) } }. A value the app's own code sets in Mushi.init / data-* attributes wins over these. Optional projectId. Read-only.

projectId.description: Project UUID — defaults to the server-configured project when omitted (`project_id` is accepted too.)
